title: RelationalDbProcessor extends IProcessor to project document operations into SQL tables with type-safe migrations and namespaced databases per drive
content:
Generate with `ph generate processor --name <name> --type relationalDb --document-types <type>`. Creates: processor class (extends `RelationalDbProcessor<DB>`), migrations.ts (up/down functions with Kysely-style schema builder), factory.ts (creates namespaced DB per drive), schema.ts (generated TypeScript types from migration via `ph generate migration-file --path <migrations-file>`). The processor lifecycle: `initAndUpgrade()` runs migrations on startup, `onOperations()` handles each batch, `onDisconnect()` cleans up. Namespaces (`getNamespace(driveId)`) prevent data collisions between drives. Data is exposed through subgraphs via `TodoIndexerProcessor.query(driveId, relationalDb)` for type-safe SQL queries.

_Corrected 2026-08-13 against Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
